title: Task Classification (Deterministic Foundation)
content:
Task Classification (Deterministic Foundation) Status: Implemented (foundation) . Classification is rule-based and serializable from ControlRequestEnvelope ; no LLM inference is used
This is used by scheduler primitives and future routed-provider integration seams
